name: young-cohorts-only
about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 1 campaign ran and brought in 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, spending $75.00 to reach 3,900 impressions and 48 clicks at a 1.2% click rate.
November 2026 has 28 days left, with $225.00 spent on Meta so far this month.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 9 leads: 8 were contacted, 4 converted to applicants, 2 applied, and 1 was hired — it is still young, so no rates yet.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 14 leads: 10 were contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, 0 hired, and 2 lost after conversion — also too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded.
